tonight.title: Avengers: Doomsday
tonight.why: Forget your troubles and dive headfirst into the ultimate superhero mashup where three universes collide! This isn't just a movie; it's a cataclysmic event you won't want to miss.

releases.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
releases.take: Before Katniss, there was another Quarter Quell, proving Panem's penchant for brutal entertainment has always been disturbingly strong.

releases.title: The Odyssey
releases.take: Odysseus's commute home makes your worst traffic jam look like a leisurely stroll, complete with mythological monsters and divine interference.

releases.title: Street Fighter
releases.take: Ryu and Ken are back to kick some serious butt, because apparently, the only way to settle differences is with a global tournament of fists, fate, and fury.

critic.title: You Can See Everything
critic.blurb: For a journey that truly tests the human spirit against gods and monsters, *The Odyssey* stands as an unrivaled epic. It’s a timeless tale of cunning and resilience, a true literary masterpiece brought to the screen.
